verdict: Paid ads remain off; organic is holding but GBP needs immediate attention.
narrative: Paid advertising on Meta and Google has been fully paused for the entire 28-day period, meaning no ad spend and no paid leads came in this period. Your Google Business Profile had been the one active channel, generating 142 actions including 48 calls and 94 website clicks over the 28 days — but profile activity dropped to zero over the last 8 days (August 23–30), which points to a listing-level issue being investigated and resolved now. Organic search is the lone bright spot, with search clicks rising nearly 19% in the most recent 7 days, showing your SEO presence is intact. Once the scope-of-work extension is signed, paid campaigns can be rebuilt and launched, and the pipeline — currently empty — will begin filling again.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions (calls + website clicks) in the last 28 days
rise in organic search clicks in the last 7 days vs. the prior 7 days
paid leads or ad spend this period — campaigns are fully paused

watch_item.issue: Your Google Business Profile went dark for 8 consecutive days through August 30, dropping all calls and clicks from that channel to zero — a listing-level event, not a gradual decline.
watch_item.fix: The listing is being audited and restored now, with a recurring posting cadence scheduled to go live by end of September to prevent a recurrence.
